'''grendelX SYCFA Flip & QMC (LS)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[grendelX]]
* '''Published:''' 23 January 2005 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif|label=Quiet Mining Colony}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Quiet Mining Colony
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 QMC grendelX LS 2005 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Bo Shek (V), Kebyc (V), Lobot (V), Luke Skywalker (V), Princess Leia (V), Civil Disorder (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Came in 14th out of 15th today for score of 4(-61) at Alderaan Worlds Qualifier My first Star Wars tournament...

== Defensive Shields ==

These cards were posted as Defensive Shields outside the deck.

* 1x {{CardLink|A Tragedy Has Occurred (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-atragedyhasoccurred.gif|label=A Tragedy Has Occurred}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Battle Plan (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-battleplan.gif|label=Battle Plan}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Aim High (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-aimhigh.gif|label=Aim High}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Do, Or Do Not (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-doordonot.gif|label=Do, Or Do Not}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Ounee Ta (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-ouneeta.gif|label=Ounee Ta}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Planetary Defenses|Ref3-L-planetarydefenses.gif}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Traffic Control (V) (Virtual Set 3)|VS3O-23-Traffic_Control.png|label=Traffic Control (V)}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Ultimatum (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-ultimatum.gif|label=Ultimatum}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Wise Advice (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-wiseadvice.gif|label=Wise Advice}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Your Insight Serves You Well (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty)|Ref3-L-yourinsightservesyouwell.gif|label=Your Insight Serves You Well}}

The ten cards listed right after An Unusual Amount Of Fear are its Defensive Shields, outside the 60.

== Notes ==

* Second deck in GPN post 5919; the Dark deck is on the (DS) page.
* Posted 'Han with Heavy Blaster Rifle x2' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol (no such rifle card; the only Han 'With Heavy Blaster' character).
* Posted BoShek (v) dested Bo Shek (V) (VS1); Traffic Control (V) (VS3) is a Defensive Shield. Other (V) cards: Luke Skywalker (V) (VS1); Kebyc (V), Lobot (V), Princess Leia (V), Civil Disorder (V) (VS6). Tantive IV is unmarked (printed).

== Strategy ==

DS 1-2/LS 1-2 22 January 2005
